authoritative_for: repository dataset counts and normalization status

hanja.semantic_derivation: mechanically split comma-delimited libhangul meaning_ko after deduplicating exact reading-character relations

notes: README files should reference this file instead of maintaining independent counts.
U+25874 is present in the character master but has no reading in the secondary mirror.
Traditional naming stroke counts must not be inferred from Unicode kTotalStrokes.
Surname core data now covers 2015 census ranks 1-31 (31 records total); the user-requested expansion file contains 30 records excluding already-built 徐(rank 13).
representative-clans-2015.csv is a partial official representative-clan table, not a complete bongwan list for each surname.
All 31 core surnames now have curated clan/genealogy research rows with evidence levels; this does not mean every clan or hangnyeol line is complete.
clans-core-2015.csv uses up to 7 selected major bongwan plus a computed remainder per surname; it is an exact-to-total summary, not a full copy of every 5+ person KOSIS bongwan row.
Hanja can have multiple documented senses. meaning-senses.csv preserves all split senses by (hanja, legal_reading); naming interpretations are a separate editorial layer.
Selected naming sense, naming intent, and semantic-risk notices are separate from dictionary senses; semantic risk is not a fortune score and only invalid evidence/readings are blocked by default.
Core Hanja normalization/index/semantic-sense files and source-audit.csv have exact regeneration scripts checked by CI.
2026 and 2027 solar-term rows were verified against KASI calendar/almanac pages on 2026-11-14.
Every registered external source has a machine-readable rights/use classification in data/meta/source-rights.csv; unverified sources default to reference/summary-only handling.
Naming semantic curation expanded from 12 characters/25 senses to 42 characters/98 reviewed senses; this remains partial coverage, not a full naming dictionary.
Four suspicious semantic source rows are explicitly held for source recheck rather than silently corrected.
Six naming-method families are now registered separately so pronunciation, resource-element, numerology, stroke, and yongshin approaches are not collapsed into one score.
48 KASI-backed month-branch boundary vectors cover the exact minute before/at each 2026-2027 monthly start solar term.
